test_contract.operation: At accepted 6-hour boundaries solve allocation with record=false, then explicitly copy optimized UserDemand allocation and per-link inflow allocation into applied UserDemand state.

comparison.statement: The explicit-apply route reproduces the observed native 6-hour saveat results exactly at reported precision for both priority cases and remains within all prospectively frozen independent-reference tolerances.

qualified_claims: An explicit UserDemand allocation-application seam is sufficient to recover the 6-hour management/physical behavior while solver.saveat remains daily.
Allocation application does not require creation of an allocation output record.
Allocation application does not require resetting cumulative supplied-volume accounting.
The DUMMY-19I failure was therefore caused by missing UserDemand application/commit at sub-saveat solves, not by inability of the allocation LP to solve at those boundaries.
Solve, apply/commit and record are separable coupling operations in the demonstrated test-only contract.
boundaries: The helper is not a production Ribasim API.
No pinned Ribasim source was modified.
downstream: Execute preregistered DUMMY-19L segment-by-segment accepted-state trajectory equivalence.
